titleEn: Smart drilling with sensors: Agrisem Chief measures in the seed furrow
titleZh: Agrisem Chief精量播种机搭载传感器实现种沟智能测量
summaryZh: 法国Agrisem公司在其Chief精量播种机上可选配来自Precision Planting的传感器，在播种过程中持续测量种沟内的土壤湿度、土壤温度及有机质/作物残茬水平，以帮助种子置于理想深度。该技术属于精准农业与智能农机范畴，对理解传感器在种植环节的应用有参考价值，但与畜牧养殖直接关联较弱。
featuredReason: 虽属大田播种领域而非畜牧养殖，但其传感器实时测量种沟环境参数的思路，对智慧畜牧中环境监测与精准投入技术的跨领域借鉴有一定启发意义。
contentFull:
Smart drilling with sensors: Agrisem Chief measures in the seed furrow

 14-10 | Smart farming | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

On the Agrisem Chief precision drill, you can optionally order sensors that continuously measure soil moisture content, soil temperature and the levels of organic matter/crop residues in the seed furrow during drilling. Photos: Koos Groenewold

 Agrisem is one of the manufacturers that uses components and parts from US manufacturer Precision Planting. In this case, they are used on the Agrisem Chief precision drill. It optionally has sensors that measure, among other things, soil moisture content and soil temperature in order to place the seed at the ideal depth. French company Agrisem, a manufacturer of soil cultivation and drilling equipment, is one of the users of drilling machine components and technology from Precision Planting
